name: Celigo MCP Server
description: Lets AI coding assistants manage Celigo integrator.io integrations, flows, connections, errors, and jobs over a hosted OAuth MCP server in the US, EU, AU, or CA region.

skills.name: Integration Resource Management
skills.description: Lists, creates, updates, and deletes integrator.io resources such as connections, exports, imports, and flows.

skills.name: Flow Runs
skills.description: Runs flows on demand and deploys marketplace templates into an integrator.io account.

skills.name: Flow Troubleshooting
skills.description: Diagnoses failing flows and connection issues with bundled MCP prompts and an error-patterns resource.
